reason: No passage states a timeout duration for remote-control signal loss before Failsafe RTH; the sources only say that, upon loss of communication, the UA would normally enter a Failsafe RTH mode, without specifying a time threshold.
The claim omits two required conditions (Home Point recorded and compass functioning normally) that the manual ties to Failsafe RTH activation.
new_text: Failsafe RTH will be automatically activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds, provided that the Home Point was recorded and the compass is functioning normally.

gaps.text: FAA guidance lacks a specific time for loss of VLOS; Matrice 210 V1 manual specifies Failsafe RTH after 3 seconds.
Matrice 210 is not in the approved collection, so the brief does not cover it.
No usable evidence found in the approved collection for DJI Matrice 210 V1 incident reports.
It is unclear if manual activation can override auto Failsafe RTH after VLOS loss.

text: FAA guidance notes there is no specific time interval for interruption of VLOS, and it requires following emergency or loss-of-control procedures when the link cannot be reestablished. The DJI Matrice 210 V1 manual claims Failsafe RTH activates automatically after more than three seconds of remote controller signal loss, provided Home Point is recorded and the compass is normal. There is no usable evidence from incident reports for the Matrice 210 V1 in the approved collection. The main gap is the conflict between a non-specific FAA timing stance and the three-second automatic Failsafe in the manual, plus unanswered questions about whether manual overrides can affect auto Failsafe RTH.
